properties.description: The INDEPENDENCE axis of the evidence-quality family (BL-136). Reads the CALIBRATED_AGAINST edges recording what a value was derived from, and marks any VERIFIES edge whose Verification IS, or PRODUCES, evidence its own target was calibrated against as CONSUMED — a fit, not a test. Consumed checks are excluded from the count of independent evidence, so a capability whose only passing checks are consumed reports as not independently verified. Structural by construction and not analytic: BL-136's originating project built four independent internal diagnostics and none could have found the defect, because no check inside a design can establish its own independence — only the outside source could. So this records and reports the relation rather than attempting to detect circularity from the evidence itself.
properties.name: Refuse to let evidence a value was fitted to count as its validation
